get_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff, density cutoff, and tolerance values from a workflow config dictionary
filter_and_deduplicate_structures_single: filter and deduplicate crystal structures from a single parquet dataset using energy, density, and connectivity criteria
filter_and_deduplicate_structures: submit parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate multiple crystal structure datasets across a directory
run_filter_single_dataset: run the filter_and_deduplicate_structures_single function on a parquet file with custom energy and density cutoff values
review_filter_config: review the get_post_relax_config function to understand default tolerance values for lattice, site, and angle matching
